notes.title: Follow our Kickstarter Pre-launch page!
notes.content: [p]Follow our Kickstarter: [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/punkzilla/combo-devils"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/punkzilla/combo-devils[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Check out our Kickstarter Pre-launch video:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/1ANmFaE3vb4?si=W5C7OnRKNMzVMYa1"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779246/0ce766b3884f150052a3ba658c352c81dc58f754.png"][/img][/p][p][b]PREPARE FOR LAUNCH![/b] [/p][p]We are finally on our way to launching our Kickstarter! [/p][p]We're not quite ready to launch the Kickstarter campaign just yet, but we wanted to let you all know that it's coming VERY soon. [/p][p]We're a small indie team and we're working hard to make our Kickstarter launch amazing.[/p][p] We have a lot planned for this Kickstarter, so be prepared! [/p][p]Head over to our Kickstarter page now, save/follow us and you'll be the first to know when we launch![/p]
